title: health.json
description: The small, world-readable health document in the profile's telemetry directory. It carries codes and timestamps only: never raw error text, IMSI, ICCID or IMEI.

modem.description: Modem label per D3: serial, or sn- plus a hash for IMEI-shaped values.

supervisor_version.description: Package version of the supervisor that wrote this document, or 'unknown'.

diagnosis.description: A diagnosis object as described by diagnosis.schema.json.

stall.description: Telemetry stall summary; only since_utc and reason_code are published here.

sim.description: Reserved for the SIM block; null until published.

registration.description: Reserved for the registration block; null until published.
